turns.input: Greet the person briefly, then ask what work they do or how they spend their days. Ask only this occupation question and wait for their answer.
turns.reply: Hello! Ungala meet pannathula happy. Neenga enna work panreenga illa eppadi unga days spend panreenga?

turns.input: நான் ஒரு சின்ன மளிகை கடை நடத்துறேன். வீட்டுக்குப் பக்கத்துல கடை இருக்கு.
turns.reply: Romba nalla vishayam! Unga shop-ku regular-ah varuvanunga, avungakooda pesurathu eppadi irukkum?
